## What's changed

- Prevented long Apple TV Discovery and local-library HLS sessions from ending early when playback catches the growing playlist edge.
- Increased the initial HLS cushion to six segments and gently generates ahead of playback so brief provider or storage delays do not exhaust it.
- Added the probed source duration to playback plans so Apple TV can distinguish the actual ending from a temporarily reached HLS edge.
- Normalized E-AC-3 audio to synchronized AAC 5.1 for Apple TV HEVC streams that require MKV-to-HLS repackaging, while preserving the original video and HDR picture.
- Left compatible MP4 playback, Tube TV, Steam, and retro-player playback paths unchanged.
